parsed.seniority_signal: Mindestens 12 Monate kontinuierliche praktische Erfahrung mit KI-Werkzeugen in der Softwareentwicklung
parsed.notes:
Ihre Qualifikationen defaults to required; idealerweise makes SAFe optional, and von Vorteil makes the three named platform products optional.
Technologies appearing only under Ihre Aufgaben are excluded, including GitLab CI/CD and operating systems.
AWS Bedrock AgentCore is provisionally mapped to aws-bedrock; review whether this distinct product instead needs its own taxonomy entry. AWS is not added as a parent.
Agentischen Skills is read literally as agent skill artifacts, not as an additional framework or agent-architecture requirement.
Understanding hallucinations does not explicitly request hallucination detection; it is therefore unmapped rather than labeled hallucination-detection.
Softwareentwicklung is treated as an explicitly named technical practice within the required practical experience.
Seniority provisionally follows the explicit 12-month experience threshold. Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Wissensvermittlung und Beratung creates ambiguity; team training is not automatically treated as a senior mentoring duty.
Organizational and railway experience, communication, teaching, and consulting are excluded as domain knowledge or soft skills. Security, Datenschutz and Compliance occur as contextual organizational requirements rather than explicit candidate technical skills.
No degree is mentioned.
